name: NHL Value
pitch: Doesn't just pick the favourite. It takes ProbaLab NHL v3's win chance for each team, sets a minimum price of 1.06 ÷ chance, and flags when the best Australian book is still at or above that price. At most one side per game.
about: This desk does not just pick the favourite. It takes ProbaLab NHL v3's win chance for each team, sets a minimum price of 1.06 ÷ chance, and flags when the best Australian book (Sportsbet, Ladbrokes, Neds, TAB, PointsBet, Unibet, or Betfair after 8% commission) is still at or above that price. At most one side per game (the bigger gap). NHL moneylines only. Flat paper 1 unit. Record starts 7 Nov 2026.
source: External NHL Value scanner publishes alerts. Empty until that pipeline writes open_bets and results.
notes: Record starts 7 Nov 2026. Flat paper 1 unit. Units only — never a bankroll. Book and price stay on this members snapshot; do not copy them onto public pages. Own snapshot only — never mixed with john, sniper, probalab, nfl-weather, or nba-price-gap. No Telegram in this repo.
isolation: Own snapshot id=nhl-value only. Never mixed with john (latest), sniper, probalab, nfl-weather, or nba-price-gap.

meta.name: NHL Value
meta.pitch: Doesn't just pick the favourite. It takes ProbaLab NHL v3's win chance for each team, sets a minimum price of 1.06 ÷ chance, and flags when the best Australian book is still at or above that price. At most one side per game.

method.markets: NHL moneyline only. At most one side per game (the bigger gap).
method.model: ProbaLab NHL v3 win chance for the side backed.
method.alert: Flag when the best Australian price is still at or above that minimum. A game can sit on Upcoming with no alert.
method.gap_pct: Fraction: alerted price × chance − 1. 0.06 means the minimum (price × chance = 1.06).
method.betfair: Use the net price after 8% commission: 1 + (price − 1) × 0.92. Store that net price as price and price_taken.
method.stake: Flat paper 1 unit. Units only. Never a bankroll.
method.scanner: Out of scope for this repo. A separate pipeline fills open_bets and results on snapshot id nhl-value.

row_schema.game_id: NHL feed id, used to mark Upcoming
row_schema.selection: same as side — required for the desk to show the row
row_schema.book: sportsbet | ladbrokes | neds | tab | pointsbet | unibet | betfair
row_schema.price: decimal odds at alert; Betfair already net of 8% commission
row_schema.model_chance: 0-1 ProbaLab NHL v3 win chance for the side
row_schema.pnl_units: null while open; net units once settled
